instruction: On the left of the desk stands a grey device with a record turntable on top. Remove the turntable platter, the black vinyl record and the tone arm completely: the top of the device becomes a completely flat, closed, plain dark grey metal lid with nothing on it. The device is a 1980s cassette deck: on the left of its front panel a smoky transparent cassette door with an audio cassette clearly visible behind it (two white reels, a label with illegible scribbles), next to it piano-key buttons and a small VU meter. A small screwdriver lies on the desk in front of the deck. No brand name, no lettering. Same painterly style and light; everything else stays exactly as it is.
